label: Nuisance
note: The general's fourth job (j_general_nuisance, general.json 'nuisance'): a port local in all green who stands in the main street outside the barracks yard and shouts at the troopers. A local like any other (Townsfolk: shoot him where they see it and the locals fight back), only he stands his spot instead of strolling (no patrol route: he looks about now and then). Spawned by GeneralPost while the job is on; killing him finishes it. His name floats over him from further off, so you can tell him from the street through a scope.
